_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROJECT MANAGEMENT PLAN' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.01.01.

f01_Project_Life_Cycle_Description.label: Project Life Cycle Description
f01_Project_Life_Cycle_Description.guidance: Description of the chosen life cycle phases, transitions, and overarching progression.

f02_Phase_Names_and_Progression.label: Phase Names and Progression
f02_Phase_Names_and_Progression.guidance: Defined sequence and boundaries of project phases from inception to closeout.

f03_Key_Phase_Activities.label: Key Phase Activities
f03_Key_Phase_Activities.guidance: Major technical and managerial activities executed across each project phase.

f04_Key_Phase_Deliverables.label: Key Phase Deliverables
f04_Key_Phase_Deliverables.guidance: Core verified outputs and milestone deliverables generated within each phase.

f05_Phase_Review_Mechanism.label: Phase Review Mechanism
f05_Phase_Review_Mechanism.guidance: Governance gates, health checks, and decision points conducted between phases.

f06_Phase_Entry_Criteria.label: Phase Entry Criteria
f06_Phase_Entry_Criteria.guidance: Mandatory readiness prerequisites and inputs required before entering each phase.

f07_Phase_Exit_Criteria.label: Phase Exit Criteria
f07_Phase_Exit_Criteria.guidance: Specific acceptance standards and approvals needed to formally close each phase.

f08_Selected_Development_Approach.label: Selected Development Approach
f08_Selected_Development_Approach.guidance: Justification for predictive, agile, hybrid, iterative, or incremental delivery.

f09_Deliverable_Specific_Approaches.label: Deliverable-Specific Approaches
f09_Deliverable_Specific_Approaches.guidance: Tailored development methodologies mapped to distinct deliverable types.

f10_Scope_and_Requirements_Management_Su.label: Scope and Requirements Management Summary
f10_Scope_and_Requirements_Management_Su.guidance: Integration summary of scope definition, baseline control, and requirements tracing.

f11_Schedule_and_Cost_Management_Summary.label: Schedule and Cost Management Summary
f11_Schedule_and_Cost_Management_Summary.guidance: Integration summary of schedule development, budgeting, and variance thresholds.

f12_Quality_and_Resource_Management_Summ.label: Quality and Resource Management Summary
f12_Quality_and_Resource_Management_Summ.guidance: Integration summary of quality standards, staffing, and team development.

f13_Communications_and_Stakeholder_Summa.label: Communications and Stakeholder Summary
f13_Communications_and_Stakeholder_Summa.guidance: Integration summary of information distribution and stakeholder engagement.

f14_Risk_and_Procurement_Summary.label: Risk and Procurement Summary
f14_Risk_and_Procurement_Summary.guidance: Integration summary of risk mitigation and vendor procurement management.

f15_Change_and_Configuration_Summary.label: Change and Configuration Summary
f15_Change_and_Configuration_Summary.guidance: Integration summary of change control procedures and configuration management.

f16_Scope_Variance_Threshold.label: Scope Variance Threshold
f16_Scope_Variance_Threshold.guidance: Defined boundary for allowable scope variance before triggering formal change control.

f17_Schedule_Variance_Threshold.label: Schedule Variance Threshold
f17_Schedule_Variance_Threshold.guidance: Permissible schedule variance limits before mandatory schedule recovery actions.

f18_Cost_Variance_Threshold.label: Cost Variance Threshold
f18_Cost_Variance_Threshold.guidance: Authorized percentage or financial variance limits before budget escalation.

f19_Scope_Baseline_Definition.label: Scope Baseline Definition
f19_Scope_Baseline_Definition.guidance: The approved project scope statement, WBS, and associated WBS dictionary.

f20_Schedule_Baseline_Definition.label: Schedule Baseline Definition
f20_Schedule_Baseline_Definition.guidance: The authorized project schedule model with baseline start and finish dates.

f21_Cost_Baseline_Definition.label: Cost Baseline Definition
f21_Cost_Baseline_Definition.guidance: The approved time-phased project budget excluding management reserves.

f22_Performance_Measurement_Baseline_PMB.label: Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB)
f22_Performance_Measurement_Baseline_PMB.guidance: Integrated scope-schedule-cost baseline used for earned value management.
